name: rareware-chain
description: Rareware Studio Blockchain Monorepo — Contracts, SDK, Cinematic dApps, RareChars AI API, and RarePay
author: Ahmed Riyaz (ARZ) <contact@rarewarestudio.space>

scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm contracts:test
scripts.contracts:build: export PATH="$HOME/.foundry/bin:$PATH" && cd packages/contracts && forge build --sizes
scripts.contracts:test: export PATH="$HOME/.foundry/bin:$PATH" && cd packages/contracts && forge test -vvv
scripts.contracts:coverage: export PATH="$HOME/.foundry/bin:$PATH" && cd packages/contracts && forge coverage --report summary
scripts.contracts:fmt: export PATH="$HOME/.foundry/bin:$PATH" && cd packages/contracts && forge fmt
